Focus areas

Our work connects mobility, housing, materials and resilience across cities worldwide.

Sustainable mobility

Safe, inclusive walking, cycling and public transport, and the decarbonisation of urban transport.

Informal settlements upgrading

Participatory upgrading that builds on what communities already have.

Sustainable materials

Research on mycelium and other low-carbon building materials.

Resilient cities

Inclusive, climate-ready urban systems and livelihoods.

About CiTra

CiTra (City Transitions) is a consultancy that supports governments, funders, development cooperation agencies and communities in making cities more sustainable, inclusive and resilient. We combine research, training and hands-on implementation, from mobility, decarbonisation and informal settlement upgrading to sustainable building materials, drawing on experience in 16 countries across four continents.

News

The latest from our projects and team.

9 November 2026 · Rundu, Namibia

Community consultation in Rundu under ISUD II

As part of the Inclusive Sustainable Development Project (ISUD II), community members in Rundu came together for an open-air consultation. Residents shared their experiences and priorities, which will help guide how the project supports inclusive and sustainable urban development. CiTra is working on ISUD II together with Integration and GIZ.

26–29 October 2026 · Chicago, USA

CiTra at the Chicago Expo 2026

Between 26 and 29 October, Dorcas Nyamai from CiTra took part in the Chicago Expo 2026. The participation was organised by the German American Chamber of Commerce under the theme of sustainability.
